runs.name: Andritz AG
runs.entry: The first name on the operator's sheet with no SEC filings. Price **EUR 81.40** per ordinary share (ANDR.VI, Vienna, close 2026-10-09, aggregator, flagged; the OTC ADR ADRZY closed USD 19.70 the same day, ADR ratio not found in any depositary document, so no per-ADR figure) x **98,310,846 shares** (104,000,000 issued less 5,689,154 treasury at 2026-06-30, FR2025 note 34 c and H1 2026 note 12 b; `cover_shares.py` returned not an SEC registrant) = cap **EUR 8,002.5M**; sovereign **3.78%** (ECB euro-area AAA 30-year spot, 2026-10-08). Primary documents the company's own Financial Report 2025 (Graz, 2026-02-24), Annual Report 2025 and H1 2026 interim report (2026-07-30), with the reports back to 2009, URLs recorded in place of accessions. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the report's business description, risk report and management report, as the overnight brief directs. Q1 IN (Pulp & Paper decides at 54.6% of 2021-2025 EBITA; 59% of its revenue service on a long-lived installed base). Q2 IN on the deciding part (installed base and service, complete-mill references; area revenue 3,987.4 in 2023 to 2,956.9 in 2025 with margin held at 10.3% to 10.8%); Metals (Schuler) open, carried at no growth. Q3 weighs for (EBITA 41% to 60% of capital employed excluding goodwill, advance-funded; acquired growth about 14% pre-tax). Q4 IN, weighs against (restructuring every year beside a featured comparable EBITA; progress-payment accounting; working capital outgrowing sales; eleven balance sheets 2015-2025: equity 1,216 to 2,456 with no new shares, net cash every year-end, net working capital -639.2 in 2011 to +118.0 in 2025). Q5 IN on integrity (losses reported plainly, the 2025 guidance miss said so, no proceeding found in the 2013-2025 reports). Q6 Part A for narrowly (retention passes in market value over five and ten years; cash deals only; 2024 buyback average EUR 56.06, below the Q7 bottom), Part B against (EBITA PSUs with no capital charge, options at grant price, annual guidance). **Q7 OUT on the floor:** expected return 0.5% to 5.5% across every case at EUR 81.40. Owner cash (operating cash less all capital spending, lease principal and acquisitions) 2016-2025 average EUR 200.0M all-equity (203.6 equity basis), used as the cycle base because 2025 fell to 69.4 on EUR 333M of acquisitions; 2021-2025 average 242.0 (253.5). Two five-year windows as the cycles is the analyst's confessed CONVENTION of this run. Net cash EUR 593.3M at 2026-06-30. Range **EUR 59.86-119.80** all-equity (equity-only 54.79-132.58); literal 2021-2025 window EUR 20.05-71.15 shown beside, fair 22.30; fair **EUR 35.02** all-equity (31.84 equity-only). Q8 to Q12 not reached. Competitors: the reports name no rival; the analyst chose Valmet (own reports), margins 4.3% to 11.9% 2014-2025 against Andritz Pulp & Paper 5.2% to 10.3%, both pulp-and-paper parts at 10.3% in 2025; Voith, SMS group, GE Vernova and the Chinese makers flagged as not obtained. Strongest evidence against: part of the net cash is customer advances that unwind when orders fall (operating cash 7.8 in 2018); fixed-price contracts (a Pulp & Paper loss in 2013 on one mill); asbestos product-liability cases; Schuler's four capacity cuts and a goodwill write-down. Could not get: the remuneration report, guarantees outstanding, asbestos provisions, group stock-pay cost, organic growth; the 2019 lease principal is estimated. Analyst's framework gaps for the operator: (1) specific (a) assumes an industry cycle and gives no way to pick cycles when troughs are deal years; (2) "operating leases left out" has no meaning for an IFRS 16 lessee; (3) a non-deciding open part "carried to Q7 at no growth" has no mechanism in Q7; (4) the basis rule subtracts all cash, part of which is customer prepayments; (5) Q1's doubt rule does not say whether doubt about single-year project timing is doubt about the circle; (6) the template's Step 0 has no non-SEC substitute. **Dispatcher's note on the alert:** `tools/v5_rerun_fold.py` arms every fair alert on the register ticker in USD; this fair price is in euros per Vienna share, so the fold was run with no fair price and the alert `ADRZY-v5-fair` was added by hand on ANDR.VI in EUR at 35.02; the passers list, which matches alerts by the register ticker, therefore shows no alert for ADRZY (a tool gap for the operator, to be met again on every foreign name). Contamination declared by the analyst: recent commit subjects and a memory index line, neither naming this company; one name search of the Test Runs listing for this company before the template copy, returning nothing; no blind-listed file opened. Nine commits (995b258e to 04556906), one per question. Citations: the analyst's check 78 ids, 33 fragments, 0 problems; the dispatcher's script (`fold_cite_check.py`) 78 ids present, 30 fragments, 0 slips. Position note filled at the fold (not held). check_framework PASS.
runs.narr: Q7 OUT on the floor at EUR 81.40 (Vienna): range EUR 59.86-119.80 all-equity on the 2016-2025 owner-cash base (the 2025 acquisitions year set aside), fair EUR 35.02; Q1 and Q2 IN on Pulp & Paper's installed base and service, margins held while the area's revenue fell a quarter in two years; Q3 for on advance-funded capital, Q4 and Q6 Part B against on a featured comparable EBITA beside yearly restructuring and pay with no capital charge. The first foreign name of the sheet; the fold tool arms alerts in USD only, so the euro alert was set by hand on ANDR.VI.
